Well Pump Repair & Installation

We repair and replace the pump that keeps your well water flowing. We don't drill wells.

Get a Quote Call 803-600-4357

What It Is

On a well home, the pump and pressure tank supply every faucet in the house. We repair existing well pumps, replace worn ones, and install new pumps. We don't drill wells.

Signs You Need It

  • No water or sputtering faucets
  • Pressure that rises and falls
  • Pump that runs constantly or clicks on and off
  • Higher electric bills from the pump

What To Expect

We test the pump, pressure switch and pressure tank to find which part failed. You'll get a plain recommendation on repair or replacement, and we restore water as quickly as the job allows.

Residential Services

What We Handle

  • Well Pump Repair

    Many well problems come from a pressure switch, control box or wiring rather than the pump itself. We test each part and repair the one that failed.

    What's included

    • Pressure switch testing and replacement
    • Control box and electrical checks
    • Checking the pump's amperage draw
    • System pressure check after repair

    Common signs you need this

    • No water at the tap
    • Pump clicking on and off rapidly
    Get a Quote

  • Pump Replacement

    When a pump is worn out, replacing it restores steady water. We match the new pump to your well and household needs.

    What's included

    • Pulling the old pump
    • Sizing the replacement pump
    • Installing and wiring the new pump
    • Startup and pressure check

    Common signs you need this

    • Pump runs but no water comes up
    • Pump is old and failing repeatedly
    • Sand or air in the water
    Get a Quote

  • New Pump Installation

    For a well that needs a new or upgraded pump, we install the pump, connect it to your plumbing, and set the system pressure.

    What's included

    • Pump selection for your well
    • Installation and wiring
    • Connection to the house supply
    • Pressure switch setup

    Common signs you need this

    • Upgrading an undersized pump
    • Bringing an existing well back into service
    Get a Quote

  • Pressure Tanks & Low Pressure

    The pressure tank keeps water pressure steady and protects the pump from running too often. We check it, recharge it, or replace it when it's failed.

    What's included

    • Pressure tank inspection
    • Air charge check and adjustment
    • Tank replacement when needed
    • System pressure test

    Common signs you need this

    • Pressure that surges and drops
    • Pump short-cycling
    • Waterlogged or leaking tank
    Get a Quote
